tweet.text:
if you're a vibe coder / builder this is for you:

our BD team, in the background has been onboarding more builders and vibe coders everyday to vibe/vibe

soon the leaderboard structure will shift where you can choose to be in one of these leaderboards:

- meme & artcoins
- infra & product
- stock & rwa

we want to reward quality projects with testnet rewards

if you are already vibe coding / building something, definitely join our discord, and our team will guide you there

since its all fake tokens on testnet there is no risk to shipping a testnet token with it

even if you work on a project for a few days, have a decent product, or even a storytelling memecoin/artcoin with an x account and website 

you'll be rewarded very well from vibe/vibe's upcoming token this way, where we are dedicating most of the 5% supply to such projects

i'd especially recommend the merge between the 3 categories, having a product or a game or something useful that integrates stock pairs, and have some of storytelling/creative aspect to it too

here is our discord for builders:

http://discord.gg/vibevibebuilders
